title: BGP RTBH
pageDescription: Remotely-triggered blackhole dispatcher. Active /32 and /128 announcements are pushed upstream via an exabgp pipe and auto-withdrawn on TTL expiry or on manual request.
notWired.banner: Module not attached. The BGP RTBH module is not wired into the running instance.
table.title: ACTIVE ANNOUNCEMENTS
table.description: Each row is a /32 or /128 announced upstream. Withdrawing revokes the announcement immediately; the TTL-based auto-revert still applies if you take no manual action.
